Context: Transactions

6. Time-limit for permission.If the prescribed authority does not communicate/ refuse its sanction within sixty days of the receipt of the request in respect of cases covered by 4 above and within thirty days in all other cases, the official is free to assume grant of sanction. - GID, Rule 8.
7. Punitive action.Non-furnishing of returns in time or furnishing wrong information will be 'good and sufficient reason' for taking disciplinary action against the officer. - GID (23), Rule 18.
